responsibility: Implements the classic structural dumper for GCC tree nodes. It manages a queue of referenced nodes with stable indices, emits formatted field-by-field representations of trees and their relationships, handles many tree-code-specific payloads such as declarations, expressions, constructors, calls, and OpenMP clauses, and underlies debugging-oriented whole-tree dumps distinct from the more C-like pretty-printer output.
same_name_distinction: Contains the concrete structural tree-dumping engine described by tree-dump.h: queue management, stable node indexing, field-by-field emission, and traversal/printing of many tree-code-specific node kinds.
